shared_example.feedback: actual service, progress and completion update the loop

presentation_scope: one overview plus three compact algorithms with functional rounded groups; numbers annotate execution arrows; implementation details in slide notes
visual_style: aligned rounded groups, distinct control/data planes and HBM/Host locations; independent owner stripes, numbered execution arrows and editable curves
shadow_policy: no offset decorative layers; explicit shape/text resets; package-wide theme, master, layout, shadow, glow, reflection and 3D effects removed
powerpoint_arrowheads: editable triangle, notched and open heads; native cubic Bezier paths, rounded control routes, closed curved transfer ribbons and wide block arrows

color_policy.accent_contrast: distinct location bodies with stable thin owner stripes
color_policy.overview_memory_tiers: HBM and Host share tier geometry and black outlines, with different background/page colors; blue control and green data planes; neutral prefix index

reference_palette.coordinate_origin: top-left; x increases rightward, y downward
reference_palette.method: Exact RGB pixel samples; no interpolated, lightened or darkened colors

typography.section_title: overview only, fitted to panel width
typography.italics: math variables and selected English condition labels
typography.numbering: black circles with white numbers placed on execution arrows

diagram_grammar.duration_bars: arrow-ended timeline intervals, not component nodes
diagram_grammar.join_candidate: forecast only; actual child RETURN still required

wait_completion_paths.child: async CPU phase/work, runtime rate hint, RCCG-bound parent
wait_completion_paths.tool: history and elapsed age, conditional end hint, owning agent
wait_completion_paths.output: candidate identity and timing for cache/admission planning

diagram_grammar.work_hint: snapshot remaining work advanced using observed effective rate
diagram_grammar.data_dependencies: native layer fences and required state; no global ACK barrier
diagram_grammar.state_selection: match the safe-input checkpoint, not simply newest state

palette.reference: Exact pixel colors from the user-provided JANUS image; semantic mapping is BeliefKV-specific

math_typography: editable Liberation Serif italic variables; positioned upright subscripts and superscripts; editable fraction bars; no rasterized equations
